title: 장보기 목록 같이 정하기: 뭘 넣고 뭘 뺄까요?
objective: Suggest items to add or remove with -(으)ㄹ 텐데.
summary: Two friends make a shopping list and give reasons with -(으)ㄹ 텐데.
setting: Jisu and Mark's living room on a Thursday evening. Jisu and her roommate Mark are writing the shopping list for a Saturday dinner party at their place before they go to the market.

task.title: Plan the list together
task.line: Use the words and the -(으)ㄹ 텐데 pattern from page 1 to complete, choose, order, or answer each item.

words.meaning: to feel too greasy or oily (food)
words.example: 피자가 좀 느끼해서 콜라를 같이 마셨어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The pizza was a bit greasy, so I had a cola with it.

words.meaning: to add (to a list or cart)
words.exampleMeaning: Please put eggs in the cart too.

words.meaning: to leave out, to take off (a list)
words.example: 저는 오이를 못 먹으니까 오이는 빼 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: I can't eat cucumber, so please leave it out.

words.meaning: to buy ahead and keep it for later
words.exampleMeaning: I'll buy the water today and keep it ready.

words.meaning: 'it will probably …, so' — gives a likely reason before a suggestion. Consonant stem + -을 텐데; vowel stem + -ㄹ 텐데 (오다 → 올 텐데); ㄹ stem: drop ㄹ and add -ㄹ 텐데 (달다 → 달 텐데).
words.example: 밖이 추울 텐데 따뜻하게 입고 가세요.
words.exampleMeaning: It's probably cold outside, so dress warmly.

dialogue.korean: 토요일 모임 장보기 목록부터 같이 정할까요?
dialogue.meaning: Shall we start by making the shopping list for Saturday's get-together?

dialogue.korean: 좋아요. 여덟 명이 오니까 고기는 넉넉하게 사야겠어요.
dialogue.meaning: Sure. Eight people are coming, so we should buy plenty of meat.

dialogue.korean: 네, 그런데 고기만 먹으면 느끼할 텐데 채소도 좀 사요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, but if we only eat meat it'll probably feel greasy, so let's get some vegetables too.

dialogue.korean: 알겠어요. 과일은 민호 씨가 가져온다고 했으니까 빼도 되겠죠?
dialogue.meaning: Got it. Minho said he'd bring fruit, so we can leave that off, right?

dialogue.korean: 네, 빼요. 아, 종이컵하고 휴지는 집에 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Yes, take it off. Oh, do we have paper cups and tissues at home?

dialogue.korean: 다 떨어졌어요. 주말에는 마트가 복잡할 텐데 내일 미리 사 둘까요?
dialogue.meaning: We're all out. The store will probably be crowded on the weekend, so shall we buy them ahead of time tomorrow?

exercises: Complete each sentence with -(으)ㄹ 텐데: ① 아이들도 ____ 주스도 사요. (있다) ② 케이크만 먹으면 ____ 커피도 사 갈까요? (달다)
Choose the right word: 민호 씨가 과일을 가져온다고 했으니까 과일은 목록에서 (넣으세요 / 빼세요).
Answer in Korean, using the dialogue: 과일은 누가 가져와요?
Put the words in order to make one sentence (put 마지막에 right before 사요): 아이스크림은 / 더울 텐데 / 사요 / 날씨가 / 마지막에
Answer in Korean with -(으)ㄹ 텐데: Your friend wants to buy a lot of fruit, but only three people are coming. Suggest buying just a little.
answers: ① 있을 텐데 ② 달 텐데
날씨가 더울 텐데 아이스크림은 마지막에 사요. / 아이스크림은 날씨가 더울 텐데 마지막에 사요.
Sample answer: 세 명만 올 텐데 과일은 조금만 사요.
